root_cause.text: `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()` in the Bluetooth L2CAP Enhanced Credit Based Flow Control receive path failed to validate that the incoming `sk_buff` contained at least 2 bytes before calling `get_unaligned_le16()` on `skb->data`, allowing an out-of-bounds read of the SDU length field.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description says `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()` “reads the SDU length field from skb->data using get_unaligned_le16() without first verifying that skb contains at least L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE (2) bytes,” and the patch fixes this by adding `pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE)` before `sdu_len = get_unaligned_le16(skb->data);`.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE description says `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()` “reads the SDU length field from skb->data using get_unaligned_le16() without first verifying that skb contains at least L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE (2) bytes,” and the patch fixes this by adding `pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE)` before `sdu_len = get_unaligned_le16(skb->data);`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check before parsing the SDU length in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv() to reject truncated packets safely.
intent_record.what: In l2cap_ecred_data_rcv(), before reading the 16-bit SDU length from skb->data when chan->sdu is null, the code now calls pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE). If that check fails, it sets err to -EINVAL and jumps to the existing failed path.
intent_record.how: This prevents the function from dereferencing packet data that may not be present in the linear portion of the skb. At runtime, malformed or truncated L2CAP packets are now rejected early instead of potentially causing out-of-bounds access or undefined behavior when extracting the SDU length.

grouping_result.intent: Add a bounds check before parsing the SDU length in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv() to reject truncated packets safely.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly fixes the reported root cause by adding a bounds check before reading the 2-byte SDU length in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv(), preventing the out-of-bounds read on truncated sk_buffs.

candidates.rationale: This statement reads a 16-bit SDU length directly from skb->data without first verifying that the skb contains at least 2 bytes, which is the out-of-bounds read described in the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This line directly reads the 16-bit SDU length from skb->data without first ensuring that the sk_buff contains at least 2 bytes, which matches the reported out-of-bounds read in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv().
